_note: The campaign. Planets open when the number of missions cleared reaches opens_at. A mission opens with its planet once every mission it requires is cleared. Each mission gives one part on its first clear and another for meeting its plus challenge, which is shown only after the first clear. Coordinates in metres: start and mech at are [x, z, yaw_deg]; unit at is [x, z, altitude], and an altitude below zero means on top of whatever stands there.

planets.name: HALDEN
planets.blurb: An industrial world of foundries and freight yards, and home port. Its towers are lit all night.
planets.gimmick: Standard gravity. A good place to learn the frame.

missions.name: GUNSHIP SWEEP
missions.scene: Two contractor gunships are circling the freight avenue. Clear the sky over Halden.

missions.name: SHAKEDOWN RUN
missions.scene: Your old wingmate bets you can't beat them down the avenue. Friendly race, no weapons.

missions.name: HOLD THE YARDS
missions.scene: An invading column is rolling on the freight yards. If more than three depots fall, Halden's supply line goes with them.

missions.name: MIRROR MATCH
missions.scene: A rival contractor has copied your frame part for part. Prove the pilot matters.

missions.name: THE BREAKWATER
missions.scene: The contractor walled off Halden's south port: a rampart a hundred and eighty metres high, guns along its crest, one gate tunnel through it. Clear the approach, break through the gate, climb the inner face, and take the guardian on top.

stages.objective: Clear the approach to the wall
Climb the inner face to the top

planets.name: SERE
planets.blurb: A desert of red mesas under a sky full of sand. You will hear things before you see them.
planets.gimmick: Sandstorm: you see a few hundred metres at most.

missions.name: CONVOY BREAK
missions.scene: A tank convoy is running the canyon road south with stolen reactor cores. Stop every one before it reaches the gate.

missions.name: GLASS NEST
missions.scene: Turrets dug into the mesa tops have closed the western pass. Break the nest; the gunships will come.

missions.name: DUNE GAUNTLET
missions.scene: The canyon racers of Sere run blind through the sand. One has challenged you.

missions.name: THE SCORPION
missions.scene: A heavy shotgun frame has been taking convoys apart up close, and a light missile frame keeps watch for it from above. Two at once.

planets.name: SPINDLE
planets.blurb: A ring of a world that broke apart, rebuilt around its own wreckage and spun for gravity. The ground curves up overhead.
planets.gimmick: Ring gravity: you are thrown outward onto the inside of the ring. Run far enough sideways and you come back round.

missions.name: SPIN-UP
missions.scene: Twelve survey drones went dark across the ring. Find and destroy them before their data is sold.

stages.objective: Destroy the drones round the dock
Run down the spin to the hub
Destroy the drones round the hub

missions.name: COLD FLOW
missions.scene: Hold the central clearing while the station's last coolant flows through. Ninety seconds.

missions.name: LONG WAY ROUND
missions.scene: The ring's couriers race a full turn of the Spindle and on down the spin. Keep your head; the floor goes up.

missions.name: KEEPER OF THE SPINDLE
missions.scene: The ring's keeper flies close to the axis and rains missiles down the curve, while two wardens hunt you along the floor. Three frames, one ring.

planets.name: RIME
planets.blurb: A pale moon of ice needles. Gravity is light and the ground gives no grip.
planets.gimmick: Low gravity and ice: jumps soar, and a frame slides into and out of every move.

missions.name: WHITEOUT
missions.scene: Gunships and turrets hold the ice plain. Clear it; mind your footing.

missions.name: SKATER
missions.scene: Rime's ice-racers run the needles low and fast. Little grip, less margin.

missions.name: THAW LINE
missions.scene: Raiders want the relay pylons on the western shelf. Lose two and the moon goes silent.

missions.name: TWIN SHADOWS
missions.scene: Two light frames that fight as one. When one dodges, the other fires.

planets.name: CINDER
planets.blurb: A world of basalt columns standing in lava. The air is ash; the ground is death.
planets.gimmick: The floor burns: every second on the bare ground costs AP. Stay on the columns or in the air.

missions.name: ASHFALL
missions.scene: Turrets on the columns are shelling the evacuation. Silence them without touching the floor more than you must.

missions.name: EMBER RUN
missions.scene: A race through the columns. Touch the lava and it will cost you more than time.

missions.name: LAST FOUNDRY
missions.scene: The last four foundries on Cinder are all that make frames like yours. Crawlers are coming through the lava for them.

missions.name: IRON VECTOR
missions.scene: The contractor's ace, in the best frame money can buy, with two gunships at its shoulders. This is the job.

planets.name: TETHYS
planets.blurb: A dead sea of black glass that no chart shows. The frames that walk here were built for wars between worlds, and they grow larger the further in you go.
planets.gimmick: Giants: every mission is a fight against a bigger frame than the last, some carrying their own gun batteries.

missions.name: FIRST GIANT
missions.scene: Something twice the size of a frame walks the glass. It is armed like one. Find out what it can take.

missions.name: TWIN COLOSSI
missions.scene: Two of them now, each larger than the first. They walk together.

missions.name: WALKING BASTION
missions.scene: A frame four times your height, with gun batteries bolted to its shoulders. Strip the guns or go for the heart.

missions.name: LEVIATHAN
missions.scene: Six times your height, six batteries, and gunships launching from the glass around it.

missions.name: THE ARK
missions.scene: The largest frame ever walked, nine times your height, with two escorts at its feet. Whoever built it is not coming back for it.
